newsitem.title: FINLAND: MERITA SAYS FINNISH RATE HIKE SPECULATION LIVES ON.
newsitem.headline: MERITA SAYS FINNISH RATE HIKE SPECULATION LIVES ON.

text.p: Merita Bank said in its weekly Nordic financial markets report that speculation of a rate hike by the Bank of Finland prevailed and this would contribute to keep the markka under pressure to strengthen.
"The market is still expecting the Bank of Finland to raise interest rates and this view is reflected in the yields on FRAs," Merita said.
"As the dollar is expected to continue strengthening and rate hike speculation prevails at home, the markka is still under strengthening pressure," it said.

Danish Unibank, in its weekly Nordic markets report, said the rate of price increase in Finland appeared to be "under control" and that the Bank of Finland's target for underlying inflation "will be met."
"The likelihood of an independent rate hike has been reduced and postponed until 1998," it said.
